# descope_voice_template (Resource)

Manages a single voice call message template for an authentication method in a Descope project. The active template is selected on the method's settings resource, e.g. the `voice_template_id` attribute of `descope_otp_settings`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (String) The text that's read aloud in voice calls made with this template. Template macros such as `{{.code}}` can be used to insert dynamic values.
- `method` (String) The authentication method the voice template is used with. Currently only `otp` is supported. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `name` (String) A name for the voice template that's unique among the templates of the same authentication method.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that the voice template belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
